entries.title: Proverbs 8:1
segments: In striking contrast with the strange woman described in the preceding chapter, heavenly Wisdom now addresses men, and invites them to receive at her hand the richest blessings.  It is the essential Wisdom of God, which dwelt with him from eternity, or, the Word, by whom his wisdom is manifested, that speaks.  See note on

. 
 
God is exceedingly earnest in his endeavors to recall men from sin and folly to heavenly wisdom.  His calls to them are so many, so loud, and so varied, that none can fail to hear but those who wilfully neglect them.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:2
segments:
vv 2-3. 
 
  In the top of high places--at the coming in at the doors; in all the most public and frequented places. She continually forces herself upon men's attention.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:8
segments: The holy Scriptures, in which the wisdom of God addresses men, contain the revelation of truth unmixed with error; and all who commit themselves to their guidance shall be led in the ways of peace, knowledge, holiness, and eternal life.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:9
segments: Plain to him that understandeth; the words of wisdom are all right and plain of apprehension; but it requires an understanding heart to receive them.  Fools derive no benefit from them.  Compare our Saviour's words, "Wisdom is justified of all her children."

The plainest and best instructions are of no avail unless there be an understanding heart to receive them.  The doctrine of Christ was an offence to the scribes and Pharisees; but all who had an humble and obedient spirit received it gladly.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:15
segments:
vv 15-16. 
 
  By me kings reign--princes rule; she commends herself to men as the counsellor and guide of all rulers.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:17
segments: God has a tender love for all who earnestly seek the truth; and if they persevere, his grace will make them successful.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:18
segments:
vv 18-21. 
 
  Riches and honor are with me--fill their treasures; she further commends herself as the only source of true riches and righteousness.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:21
segments: Wisdom is the most excellent of all possessions, having the promise of this life and that which is to come.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:22
segments:
The Lord possessed me; the crowning commendation of wisdom: she is the eternal companion of God, his delight, rejoicing always before him, and present at all his works. 
 
In all God's revelations eternal wisdom addresses men, but in the Lord Jesus Christ, who is the Word made flesh, he has given us a full manifestation of that infinite and uncreated wisdom which he possessed "from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was."  To hear and obey Christ, is to receive heavenly wisdom, and with her, eternal life.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:26
segments: The highest part of the dust; the mountain tops; or, The chief part of the dust.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:27
segments: Set a compass; formed the circular vault of heaven, or exactly formed all parts of the universe.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:30
segments:
vv 30-31. 
 
  Then I was by him--delights were with the sons of men; see note on

entries.title: Proverbs 8:31
segments: The love of God for men equals his almighty power to do them good.  He earnestly desires that they should listen to his voice, that he may make them most blessed for ever.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:34
segments: My gates--posts of my doors; waiting at her royal palace to receive instruction.  Compare
